relevance_note: A case report of a Japanese family with two siblings carrying the same TNFAIP3 variant: "This heterozygous C200A fs*16 mutation was present in the patient’s younger sister".
method_note: Read by hand; a Python script in the scratch directory only assembled the JSON from hand-chosen values and checked spans. Scope: proband (label 'patient', the main unnamed patient of this letter), his affected younger sister (carrier), his affected untested deceased mother, and his tested-negative unaffected father. The younger brothers ("Sequence analysis was not possible on the younger brothers of the proband without symptoms") are neither tested nor affected and get no rows; their number is not stated. Contradictions in the paper: (1) cDNA given as "C596_598 del A" in the text but "c597-598 T deletion" in the Fig. 1 legend; the text form is recorded, neither has a 'c.' prefix as printed. (2) The variant is called a frameshift (text and Fig. 1) but also "a novel heterozygous missense mutation" in both siblings in the Discussion; variant_type left 'not reported' because of this. (3) "There were no abnormalities except elevated levels of C-reactive protein (CRP)" conflicts with positive ANA, raised serum amyloid A (30 μg/dL (<8.0)) and alkaline phosphatase (424 IU/L (80-250)) in Table S1; the lab table values beyond CRP/ANA were not converted into features. Inheritance left 'not reported': the father tested negative and the mother was not tested; the paper only says "suggesting that these mutations were maternally derived". Age at onset for the proband left 'not reported': the Discussion gives "the disease onset (at 14 years old)" without naming which of "our patients"; age at last evaluation left 'not reported' because he was 17 at referral but admitted "Three years later" (timeline unclear). Sister's "similar symptoms" are unspecified, so she has no feature rows. Table S1 '(-)' autoantibody cells are not defined in a legend; exclusion of other autoantibodies rests on the text. Urinalysis 'normal' recorded as excluded 'abnormal urinalysis' (whole investigation, nothing more specific excluded). Uveitis not confirmed does not exclude the broader checklist item. No stacked cells.
